sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: Mythical Void does not collect any personal information. All game data including your creatures, progress, and preferences are stored locally on your device using browser localStorage. This data never leaves your device and is not transmitted to our servers or any third party.

sections.heading: Local Storage
sections.content:
Your game saves are stored in your browser's localStorage. This means:
• Your data stays on YOUR device only
• Clearing browser data will delete your saves
• We cannot access or recover your game data
• No account or login is required

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.content:
Mythical Void uses the following external services:
• NASA APIs: We fetch publicly available astronomical images and data. No personal information is sent to NASA.
• Netlify/Vercel: Our game is hosted on static hosting services that maintain standard server access logs (IP addresses, timestamps). We do not access or analyze these logs.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.content:
Mythical Void is designed for players of all ages, including children. We are committed to protecting children's privacy:
• We do NOT collect personal information from anyone, including children
• No account creation is required
• No email, name, or location data is collected
• All gameplay is entirely offline and local

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.content:
Since all data is stored locally on your device, you maintain full control over your game data. We recommend:
• Regularly backing up important browser data
• Being aware that clearing browser cache will delete saves
• Not sharing your device with untrusted individuals

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected in the 'Last Updated' date. Continued use of Mythical Void after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
